1.1: Kelal amru bammaasrot, kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulav min haaretz, chayyav bammaasrot. veod kelal acher amru, kol shettechillato ochel vesofo ochel, af al pi shehu shomro lehosif ochel, chayyav katan vegadol. vechol sheen techillato ochel aval sofo ochel, eno chayyav ad sheyyease ochel:
1.2: Meematay happerot chayyavot bammaasrot. hatteenim, mishsheyyavchilu. haanavim vehoovashim, mishshehivishu. haog vehattutim, mishsheyyadimu. vechol haadummim, mishsheyyadimu. harimmonim, mishsheyyimmassu. hattemarim, mishsheyyattilu seor. haafarsekim, mishsheyyattilu gidim. haegozim, mishsheyyaasu megura. rabbi yehuda omer, haegozim vehashshekedim, mishsheyyaasu kelippa:
1.3: Hecharuvin, mishsheyyinnakedu. vechol hashshechorim, mishsheyyinnakdu. haagasim vehakkerustomelin vehapparishin vehauzradim, mishsheyyikkarechu. vechol hallevanim, mishsheyyikkarechu. hattiltan, mishshettetzammeach. hattevua vehazzetim, mishsheyyachnisu shelish:
1.4: Uvayyarak, hakkishshuin vehaddeluim vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot, hattappuchim vehaetrogin, chayyavim gedolim uketannim. rabbi shimon poter et haetrogim bekatnan. hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim, patur bammetukim, hachayyav bammetukim, patur bammarim:
1.5: Ezehu garnan lammaasrot. hakkishshuim vehaddeluim, mishsheyyefaksu. veim eno mefakkes, mishsheyyaamid arema. avattiach, mishsheyyeshallek. veim eno meshallek, ad sheyyaase muktze. yarak hanneegad, mishsheyyogad. im eno oged, ad sheyyemalle et hakkeli. veim eno memalle et hakkeli, ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko. kalkala, ad sheyyechappe. veim eno mechappe, ad sheymalle et hakkeli. veim eno memalle et hakkeli, ad sheyyelakket kol tzarko. bamme devarim amurim, bemolich lashshuk. aval bemolich leveto, ochel mehem aray ad shehu maggia leveto:
1.6: Happered vehatztzimmukin vehecharuvin, mishsheyyaamid arema. habbetzalim, mishsheyyefakkel. veim eno mefakkel, mishsheyyaamid arema. hattevua, mishsheyyemareach. veim eno memareach, ad sheyyaamid arema. hakkitniyyot, mishsheyyichbor. veim eno chover, ad sheyyemareach. af al pi shemmerach, notel min hakkuttaim umin hatztzedadim umimma shebbetoch hatteven, veochel:
1.7: Hayyayin, mishsheyyekappe. af al pi shekkippa, kolet min haggat haelyona umin hatztzinnor, veshote. hashshemen, mishsheyyered lauka. af al pi sheyyarad, notel min heakal umibben hammamal umibben happatztzim, venoten lachamitta velattamchuy, aval lo yitten lakkedera velallefas keshehen rotchin. rabbi yehuda omer, lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir:
1.8: Haiggul, mishsheyyachalikennu. machalikim bitenim uvaanavim shel tevel. rabbi yehuda oser. hammachalik baanavim, lo huchshar. rabbi yehuda omer, huchshar. haggerogarot, mishsheyyadush. umegura mishsheyyeaggel. haya dash bechavit umeaggel bammegura, nishbera hechavit veniftecha hammegura, lo yochal mehem aray. rabbi yose mattir:

2.1: Haya over bashshuk veamar, telu lachem teenim, ochlin ufeturin. lefichach im hichnisu levattehem, metakkenim vadday. telu vehachenisu levattechem, lo yochlu mehem aray. lefichach im hichnisu levattehem, enam metakkenim ella demay:
2.2: Hayu yoshvin bashshaar o vachanut, veamar, telu lachem teenim, ochlin ufeturin, uvaal hashshaar uvaal hachanut chayyavin. rabbi yehuda poter, ad sheyyachazir et panav, o ad sheyyeshanne mekom yeshivato:
2.3: Hammaale ferot min haggalil lihuda, o ole lirushalayim, ochel mehem ad shehu maggia lemakom shehu holech, vechen bihuda. rabbi meir omer, ad shehu maggia limkom hashshevita. veharochlin hammechazzerin baayarot, ochlim ad shemmaggiim limkom hallina. rabbi yehuda omer, habbayit harishon hu veto:
2.4: Perot shetteraman ad shello nigmera melachtan, rabbi eliezer oser milleechol mehem aray. vachachamim mattirin, chutz mikkalkalat teenim. kalkalat teenim shetteramah, rabbi shimon mattir, vachachamim osrin:
2.5: Haomer lachavero, helach issar ze veten li vo chamesh teenim, lo yochal ad sheyyeasser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, ochel achat achat, patur, veim tzeraf, chayyav. amar rabbi yehuda, maase veginnat veradim shehayta virushalayim, vehayu teenim nimkarot mishshalosh umearba beissar, velo hufrash mimmenna teruma umaaser meolam:
2.6: Haomer lachavero, helach issar ze beeser teenim sheavor li, borer veochel. beeshkol sheavor li, megarger veochel. berimmon sheavor li, poret veochel. baavattiach sheavor li, sofet veochel. aval im amar lo beesrim teenim elu, bishne eshkolot elu, bishne rimmonim elu, bishne avattichim elu, ochel kedarko ufatur, mippene shekkana vimchubbar lakkarka:
2.7: Hassocher et happoel liktzot immo bitenim, amar lo al menat sheochal teenim, ochel ufatur. al menat sheochal ani uvene veti, o sheyyochal beni bischari, hu ochel ufatur, uveno ochel vechayyav. al menat sheochal bishat hakketzia uleachar hakketzia, bishat hakketzia ochel ufatur, uleachar hakketzia ochel vechayyav, sheeno ochel min hattora. ze hakkelal, haochel min hattora, patur, vesheeno ochel min hattora, chayyav:
2.8: Haya ose vilvasim, lo yochal bivnot sheva. bivnot sheva, lo yochal bilvasim. aval monea hu et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel. hammachalif im chavero, ze leechol veze leechol, ze liktzot veze liktzot, ze leechol veze liktzot, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, hammachalif leechol, chayyav, veliktzot, patur:

3.1: Hammaavir teenim bachatzero liktzot, banav uvene veto ochlin ufeturin. happoalim sheimmo, bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot, ochlin ufeturin. aval im yesh lahem alav mezonot, hare ellu lo yochelu:
3.2: Hammotzi poalav lassade, bizman sheen lahem alav mezonot, ochlin ufeturin. veim yesh lahem alav mezonot, ochlin achat achat min hatteena, aval lo min hassal velo min hakkuppa velo min hammuktze:
3.3: Hassocher et happoel laasot bezetim, amar lo al menat leechol zetim, ochel echad echad ufatur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. lenakkesh bivtzalim, amar lo al menat leechol yarak, mekartem ale ale veochel. veim tzeraf, chayyav:
3.4: Matza ketzitzot badderech, afillu vetzad sede ketzitzot, vechen teena shehi nota al derech, umatza tachteha teenim, muttarot mishshum gazel ufeturot min hammaasrot. uvezetim uvecharuvim, chayyavim. matza gerogarot, im darsu rov bene adam, chayyav, veim lav, patur. matza filche devela, chayyav, sheyyadua shehen middavar gamur. vehecharuvin, ad shello chenasan lerosh haggag, morid mehem livhema, patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar:
3.5: Ezo hi chatzer shehi chayyevet bammaasrot, rabbi yishmael omer, chatzer hatztzorit, shehakkelim nishmarim betochah. rabbi akiva omer, kol sheechad poteach veechad noel, petura. rabbi nechemya omer, kol sheen adam bosh milleechol betochah, chayyevet. rabbi yose omer, kol shennichnas lah veen omer ma atta mevakkesh, petura. rabbi yehuda omer, shene chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, happenimit chayyevet, vehachitzona petura:
3.6: Haggaggot peturin, af al pi shehem shel chatzer hachayyavet. bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset, hare ellu kechatzer, im chayyevet, chayyavin, veim petura, peturim:
3.7: Hatztzerifin vehabburganin vehaelkatiyyot, peturin. sukkat ginnosar, af al pi sheyyesh bo rechayim vetarnegolim, petura. sukkat hayyotzrim, happenimit chayyevet, vehachitzona petura. rabbi yose omer, kol sheenah dirat hachamma vedirat haggeshamim, petura. sukkat hechag bechag, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
3.8: Teena shehi omedet bechatzer, ochel achat achat ufatur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. rabbi shimon omer, achat bimino veachat bismolo veachat befiv. ala leroshah, memalle cheko veochel:
3.9: Gefen shehi netua vechatzer, notel et kol haeshkol. vechen berimmon, vechen baavattiach, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, megarger baeshkolot, uforet barimmon, vesofet baavattiach. kusbar shehi zerua vechatzer, mekartem ale ale veochel. veim tzeraf, chayyav. hassea vehaezov vehakkoranit shebbechatzer, im hayu nishmarim, chayyavin:
3.10: Teena shehi omedet bechatzer venota lagginna, ochel kedarko ufatur. omedet bagginna venota lechatzer, ochel achat achat, patur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. omedet baaretz venota lechutza laaretz, bechutza laaretz venota laaretz, hakkol holech achar haikkar. uvevatte are choma, hakkol holech achar haikkar. uveare miklat, hakkol holech achar hannof. uvirushalayim, hakkol holech achar hannof:

4.1: Hakkovesh, hashsholek, hammoleach, chayyav. hamechammen baadama, patur. hametabbel bassade, patur. happotzea zetim sheyyetze mehem hasseraf, patur. hassochet zetim al besaro, patur. im sachat venatan letoch yado, chayyav. hamekappe letavshil, patur. likdera, chayyav, mippene shehu chevor katan:
4.2: Tinokot shettamnu teenim leshabbat, veshachchu leasseran, lo yochlu lemotzae shabbat ad sheyyeasseru. kalkalat shabbat, bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayyevin. rabbi yehuda omer, af halloket et hakkalkala lishloach lachavero, lo yochal ad sheyyitasser:
4.3: Hannotel zetim min hammaatan, tovel echad echad bemelach veochel. im malach venatan lefanav, chayyav. rabbi eliezer omer, min hammaatan hattahor chayyav, umin hattame patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar:
4.4: Shotim al haggat, ben al hachammin ben al hatztzonen patur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok mechayyev. vachachamim omrim, al hachammin chayyav, veal hatztzonen patur:
4.5: Hamekallef seorim, mekallef achat achat veochel. veim killef venatan letoch yado, chayyav. hammolel melilot shel chittim, menappe miyyad leyad veochel. veim nippa venatan letoch cheko, chayyav. kusbar shezzeraah lezera, yarkah patur. zeraah leyarak, mitasseret zera veyarak. rabbi eliezer omer, hashshevet mitasseret zera veyarak vezerin. vachachamim omrim, eno mitasser zera veyarak ella hashshachalayim vehaggargir bilvad:
4.6: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, temarot shel tiltan veshel chardal veshel pol hallavan, chayyavot bammaaser. rabbi eliezer omer, hatztzalaf mitasser temarot vaaviyyonot vekafras. rabbi akiva omer, en mitasser ella aviyyonot, mippene shehen peri:

5.1: Haoker shetalim mittoch shello venata letoch shello, patur. lakach bimchubbar lakkarka, patur. lakat lishloach lachavero, patur. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, im yesh kayyotze vahem nimkarim bashshuk, hare ellu chayyavin:
5.2: Haoker lefet utzenonot mittoch shello venotea letoch shello lezera, chayyav, mippene shehu garnan. betzalim, mishshehishrishu vaaliyya, taharu milletamme. nafla alehem mappolet vehem megullim, hare ellu kintuim bassade:
5.3: Lo yimkor adam et perotav mishebbau leonat hammaasrot lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, velo vashsheviit lemi shehu chashud al hashsheviit. veim bikkeru, notel et habbakkurot umocher et hashshear:
5.4: Lo yimkor adam et tivno veet gifto veet zaggav lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, lehotzi mehen mashkin. veim hotzi, chayyav bammaasrot ufatur min hatteruma, shehattorem, belibbo al hakketuim, al hatztzedadim veal ma shebbetoch hatteven:
5.5: Hallokeach sede yarak besureya, im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot, chayyav. umishshebba leonat hammaasrot, patur, veloket kedarko veholech. rabbi yehuda omer, af yiskor poalim vilakket. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bizman shekkana karka, aval bizman shello kana karka, im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot, patur. rabbi omer, af lefi cheshbon:
5.6: Hametammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza chede middato, patur. rabbi yehuda mechayyev. matza yoter al kede middato, motzi alav mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon:
5.7: Chore hannemalim shellanu vetzad haarema hachayyevet, hare ellu chayyavim, sheyyadua shemmiddavar haggamur hayu gorrin kol hallayla:
5.8: Shum baal bechi, uvatzal shel richpa, ugerisin hakkilkin, vehaadashim hammitzriyyot, rabbi meir omer, af hakkarkas, rabbi yose omer af hakkutenim, peturim min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit. zera luf haelyon, zera kereshim, zera betzalim, zera lefet utzenonot, ushear zerone ginna sheenan neechalim, peturim min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit, sheaf al pi sheavihen teruma, hare ellu yeachelu:
